Items that surprise travelers the most:: The items that most often surprise travellers: excess baggage fees, exchange-rate differences on cards, night-time airport transfers, and cancellation or change fees. In some cases these can add 500-1,200 riyals ($133-320) to the trip without you noticing early on. So compare the final price after all the extras, not just the headline base price.
Before accepting any offer, check: cance: Before accepting any offer, check the cancellation policy, local taxes, apartment cleaning fees and check-in times. A late arrival may mean paying for an extra night or a more expensive transfer. An accurate arrival schedule limits these losses and makes your financial planning more realistic.
